$comment: Logix instruction / service catalog for plc-ir 2.0 sysCall nodes with catalog = logix. Generated from src/L5x/Parsing/Rll/InstructionSignatures.txt (1756-RM014 neutral text table) and hand-grouped; parameter names from 1756-RM003 where known, argN otherwise. lowered = true marks instructions the Logix front-end never emits as sysCall (they become contacts, coils, assignments, standard function blocks, copies or action calls). enable = input marks instructions that run every scan and read the rung condition; gate marks instructions that run only when the rung condition is true.
